title: Chapter 1476 - 15: On The Road (Grand Finale Tomorrow)
content:
Chapter 1476 - 15: On The Road (Grand Finale Tomorrow)

Chapter 1476: Chapter 15: On the Road (Grand Finale Tomorrow)

The slaughter did not cease due to the ’involuntary intrusion’ of the Lord of Wanwei. Horrific beings from different times and spaces, regardless of how they struggled, rapidly perished under the sweep of invisible forces, erasing traces of their existence in past, present, and future.

"What... what on earth is happening? I’ve never heard of such a thing. So many lords falling at once, and completely at that, is it covered by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao?"

Lord Wanwei was as silent as a cicada in winter. Having observed countless timelines and traveled through many future spaces, he had never heard of the present age’s Legendary Lords, like dust, being slaughtered.

Rumble.

In the distance.

Rippled threads of invisible forces, a figure was forced into visibility; it was the Returning Ruins Lord.

Confronted by the invisible forces, even beings nearing the end of the path to transcendence were merely clinging to life, let alone the Returning Ruins Lord, who had survived only three billion and one thousand calamities?

Flesh, soul, mind, and will continually perished, and all life-saving measures left from past, present, and future were impacted, this feeling of impending complete annihilation terrified the Returning Ruins Lord.

"Supreme Rule Dao’s will, Supreme Rule Dao’s will, why don’t you come out? Is this the target you wanted us to stop? Hahahaha! Damn Supreme Rule Dao’s will!"

At the point of death, the Returning Ruins Lord let go completely, filled with endless resentment and unwillingness, he began to curse the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

Indeed.

Even if they failed this calamity test, there was no threat of being erased by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will.

It sounded very convenient.

But given the methods Lin Yuan showed now.

Would it need the Supreme Rule Dao’s will to erase? Directly erased by the Galaxy Lord.

It wasn’t only the Returning Ruins Lord who resented the Supreme Rule Dao’s will. Other Legendary Lords and horrific beings felt the same.

Lin Yuan’s deadly strike against them was entirely understandable.

After all, they pushed things to the extreme first, using the Galaxy Lord’s family and friends as threats.

Such behavior by the Galaxy Lord was utterly normal.

But the Supreme Rule Dao’s will?

The horrific beings that transcended billions of calamities knew of the usual calamity imposed by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, which, although challenging, held hope for completion.

Even if hope was dim, it was never entirely impossible to surpass.

But now?

Faced with the Galaxy Lord, seated atop the heights of time and space, they were like fish on a chopping board, unable to block nor escape his advancement along the path of transcendence.

How to transcend?

With what to transcend?

Under such circumstances, the Supreme Rule Dao’s will naturally became the venting object for all Legendary Lords and horrific beings on the brink of death.

"I don’t understand, why would the Supreme Rule Dao’s will impose a calamity with no hope of completion? To let us die?"

"Or is it that the end of the ’Infinite Calamities’ path of transcendence is a dead end, and any lord nearing this end comes to this space to be erased by the Galaxy Lord?"

One by one, horrific beings faded with endless unwillingness and resentment.

The Returning Ruins Lord naturally would be no exception. However, before completely vanishing, he voluntarily detonated life-saving contingencies left in different times and spaces, scattering them as pure resentment and obsession across many spaces.

These pure resentments and obsessions could not serve as a backup for the Returning Ruins Lord’s revival, only carrying a message or a few words as a warning left for future lords—

"...Don’t go! Absolutely don’t go!!!"

...

The slaughter continued. Lord Wanwei, standing dazed in the corner of the battlefield, naturally heard the venting of countless horrific beings’ unwilling resentment as they faced death.

"Would the Supreme Rules impose a calamity?"

"Is the path of transcendence through Infinite Calamities a dead end?"

"Will the final calamity cause the calamity bearer to arrive in this space?"

Lord Wanwei shuddered. He thought of himself, continuing down the ’Infinite Calamities’ path of transcendence, would also face that figure seated at the heights of time and space.

Buzz buzz buzz~ Invisible forces continued to sweep, finally re-covering the battlefield corner where Lord Wanwei stood.

Lord Wanwei chuckled bitterly, his heart devoid of even despair.

He was worried about the future?

From what he’s seen, any existence touched by invisible forces will completely vanish; Lord Wanwei inadvertently intruded upon this space, trapped within it, unable to return to his original time-space, the outcome was essentially doomed.

Like other horrific beings and Legendary Lords, completely vanishing in this space.

"So be it."

"Dying in the future makes no difference from dying now."

Lord Wanwei’s thoughts surged; if destined to face the figure seated at the heights of time and space in the future, he would rather be completely gone now.

Lord Wanwei was unwilling to find himself returning to this space in the future.

Just then.

Lin Yuan, seated at the heights of time and space, seemed to notice something, glancing down at a corner of the battlefield.

Lin Yuan looked down at the Lord Wanwei, standing dumbstruck awaiting death. Though he had never seen him before, he had felt his presence within Wanwei space.

"Did you accidentally intrude upon this space?"

In an instant, Lin Yuan understood why the Lord Wanwei appeared here.

Given Lord Wanwei’s strength, he simply didn’t have the qualification to be guided by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will to come here and stop him.

"Return, back to your own space-time."

Lin Yuan once more shut his eyes.

In some aspects, he had benefited from the ’favor’ of the Lord Wanwei, whose opening of Wanwei space had greatly benefited Lin Yuan.
